method_note: Primary sources: SEC EDGAR submissions, companyfacts, 8-K Ex-99.1, 10-Q and 10-K. Rate check: 10y UST 5.17% (25 Sep 2026) + Blume beta x ERP 4.14% (V1 convention) unless the dossier states its own ERP. Reverse DCFs re-solved (10 years, stated terminal growth) with SBC treated as a cost and levered FCF paired with equity value (or unlevered FCF with EV). LMT dossier already carries a DVH4 correction section (6 Oct 2026); only residual items are reported here.
